text: This reland adds a notSet default to the shared addMessage fixture and forwards priority after tags, matching the extended required interface argument. The original landing added the schema and interface parameter but left the helper call ending at tags. The reland adds no direct priority assertion, so this call repair does not prove cache round-trip behavior, a passing test or the historical failure's sole cause.
title: The Panorama reland passes the required priority through the shared test fixture
